market.summary: Overnight cues are mildly positive. The Fed held rates at 3.75-4.00% in a 10-2 vote (two members wanted a hike), the S&P 500 rose 0.3% for a third straight gain, Korea's Kospi jumped 6.6% on SK Hynix's results, and GIFT Nifty points to a start about 55 points higher. Foreign and domestic funds were both net buyers yesterday. Oil is still the risk: Brent is around $111-114, well above where it was a month ago.

points.text: Fed kept its rate at 3.75-4.00%; Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack voted for a quarter-point hike. Chair Warsh said earlier moves are starting to work. US 10-year yield about 5.02%.
GIFT Nifty about 22,789 (+55) this morning, Brent near $114; provisional flows on 28 Oct: FIIs bought Rs 871 Cr, DIIs bought Rs 643 Cr.
Close 28 Oct: Sensex -352.64 (-0.48%) at 73,246.03; Nifty -50.90 (-0.22%) at 22,698.85; Midcap +0.4%, Smallcap +0.9%; 2,178 advances vs 1,957 declines.

market.watch: A gap-up open on positive global cues; Brent above $115 again would hit the consumer and hotel names first.

GROWW.summary: No new results news overnight. One item not covered last evening: two promoter trusts (Golden Oak and Mufasa) disclosed on 28 Oct pledges created on 19 Oct with Aditya Birla Capital, about 0.24% of the equity each, for 'personal reasons'. The founders' trusts have pledged shares with the same lender since March, so this is a top-up rather than a new worry. The plan's exit from the closes below 188.75 still stands; yesterday's close of 190.30 is only just above it.

points.text: Promoter entity Golden Oak Trust pledged 15 lakh shares and Mufasa Trust 8.75 lakh shares with Aditya Birla Capital on 19 Oct (about 0.24% of capital each), reason given as personal; disclosed 28 Oct.
The founders' trusts first pledged about 1.88 Cr shares (~Rs 302 Cr) with Aditya Birla Capital in March 2026, also for personal reasons.
Close Rs 190.30 vs entry Rs 200.80 and stop Rs 188.75: -0.87R (-5.2%); +1R would be Rs 212.85.
Last exchange filing is the 16 Oct call transcript; no bulk / block / short deals in the last 10 days.

GROWW.watch: The plan's exit stands; if still held, a close back under 188.75 is the line. Tell Claude the exit price once sold.

TIPSMUSIC.summary: No new news since last evening. TIPSMUSIC.watch: Stop at cost 727.89 on a closing basis; after a 7% one-day jump on no news, some give-back would be normal.

ORIENTELEC.summary: No new news since last evening. No new filing or news today. The stock was flat at 187.27, right at the 187.44 entry, while consumer durables rose about 1%. The results story is good (revenue +25%, profit more than doubled), but gross margin fell 2.5 points because copper and other metals rose faster than prices, and Brent above $110 keeps that cost worry alive.

points.text: Q2 FY27: revenue Rs 879 Cr (+25.2% YoY), EBITDA +49.7% to Rs 57 Cr, PAT Rs 27 Cr vs Rs 12 Cr; EBITDA margin 6.5% (+106 bps) but gross margin 29% (-2.5 pts).
Copper near $14,500 a tonne, about double early-2024; price hikes recovered 80-100% of the cost rise depending on the product.
Close Rs 187.27 vs entry Rs 187.44: -0.01R; stop Rs 171.27, +1R Rs 203.61.

ORIENTELEC.watch: Hold above the 173.00 result-day low (stop 171.27); copper and crude are the swing factors for margins.
